about: Looks: graphics packs, UI looks and graphics presets (stream/looks.py, mods/SPEC.md "Looks"). Only reviewed entries are published (on /wrath/looks and in /wrath/mods/all.json as source "look"). Nothing here is hosted by us: one-click installs come from the author's own release with a pinned sha256 (install), from reviewed curated addons (look.uses), or are the launcher's own settings (look.preset). Edit with tools/looks/looks.py (check, list, approve, pin).

looks.name: Max
looks.description: Everything turned up: the farthest view, the sharpest textures and filtering, high shadows, thick grass and full weather. For a strong graphics card.
looks.author: Leyline

previews.alt: A misty village path between tall trees and timber houses, in soft morning light

look.note: Changes the game's own settings file. Back to the original look puts your old settings back.

review.notes: Ours: the Graphics page's Ultra settings.

looks.name: Balanced
looks.description: A good look that stays smooth on most computers: a long view, soft shadows, sharp textures and a little less grass.
looks.author: Leyline

previews.alt: A forest of huge trees glowing pink and purple

look.note: Changes the game's own settings file. Back to the original look puts your old settings back.

review.notes: Ours: the Graphics page's Balanced settings.

looks.name: Classic
looks.description: The game the way it looked on day one: the original view distance, no extra shadows, plain filtering and the soft full-screen glow.
looks.author: Leyline

previews.alt: A foggy town square at night, lit by lamps, with a bare tree

look.note: Changes the game's own settings file. Back to the original look puts your old settings back.

review.notes: Ours: the new Classic preset in gfx.rs.

looks.name: Forever UI
looks.description: A modern interface for the classic client: new action bars, unit frames, bags, a new login screen and character select. The browser game already uses it.
looks.author: Adrestie
looks.licence_source: the repo's licence (its code); its art comes from the newer client and has no licence of its own

previews.alt: The game screen with the Forever UI look: action bars, unit frames, chat and minimap
Character select with the Forever UI look
The character window with the Forever UI look
The professions window with the Forever UI look

look.note: Its art comes from the newer client, so we never host it and the launcher does not install it yet: get it from its author's page.

review.notes: Link only: already our default look in the browser stream (play/Install Forever UI.bat fetches it from the author).

looks.name: DragonflightUI
looks.description: Modern-styled unit frames, cast bar and chat over the classic interface.
looks.author: yuritsuki

review.notes: One click once up:dragonflightui is approved in the addon curation (its .blp art needs a look first); a link until then.

looks.name: pfUI
looks.description: A complete, clean replacement interface: unit frames, bars, bags, chat and nameplates in one, set up in game.
looks.author: shagu

look.note: Replaces your whole interface. Get it from its author's page; one click comes when our addon checks cover these clients.

review.notes: Link only: MIT, archived (read only) since June 2026; the addon curation only covers the third-era client today.

looks.name: UltraHD Graphics Modpack
looks.description: Higher-resolution textures, new models, richer lighting and denser foliage for the classic client, made for the Conquest community client.
looks.author: the Conquest of Azeroth modpack authors

look.note: External download, made and hosted by its authors; not checked or hosted by Leyline.

review.notes: Link only, the owner's exception of 2026-10-30 (tools/hub-index/external-packs.json).

looks.name: Epoch water
looks.description: Clearer, livelier water for lakes, rivers and the sea. One small patch file.
looks.author: the Project Epoch team (shared by ZythDr)
looks.licence_source: README: "free for anyone to use, even other servers" (no licence file)

look.note: External download, made and hosted by its authors; not checked or hosted by Leyline.

review.notes: Link only, like the UltraHD link (owner 2026-10-30: 'and other similar'). The repo has no release to pin, so no one click.

looks.name: ElvUI
looks.description: A complete replacement interface: unit frames, action bars, bags, chat, nameplates and data texts in one package you set up in game.
looks.author: the ElvUI backport team

look.note: Replaces your whole interface; may conflict with the Leyline UI.

review.notes: Needs the owner: no licence; the curated entry lists a missing file; replaces the whole UI.

looks.name: Aurora
looks.description: A clean, flat look for the default interface windows.
looks.author: Bunny67

review.notes: Needs the owner: no licence, and one .blp named like stock art (Aurora/Media/UI-LFG-ICON-ROLES.blp).

looks.name: Clean frames
looks.description: A lighter interface in one click: slim unit frames, movable action bars and a modern minimap, from three addons.
looks.author: bkader and s0h2x

look.note: Three addons from their authors: RUF Unit Frames, Dominos and Pretty Minimap.

review.notes: Needs the owner: a look we name made of three approved addons whose repos state no licence.

looks.name: Project Reforged
looks.description: A library of small graphics patches for the classic-era client you pick one by one: character models, creatures, water and more.
looks.author: the Project Reforged contributors

look.note: External download, made and hosted by its authors; not checked or hosted by Leyline.

review.notes: Needs the owner: no licence stated, download hosts not named, and its page is made for one community client.
